name: ES-CL Lead-Lag Study (8:00-9:00 AM ET)
description: Intraday lead-lag study between ES and CL on 5-min bars. Defines two 30-min windows: Window 1 (8:00-8:30 AM ET) as the signal window, and Window 2 (8:30-9:00 AM ET) as the response window. Tests both directions: (1) ES leads CL — when ES moves >0.5% in W1, measure CL's W2 return; (2) CL leads ES — when CL moves >0.5% in W1, measure ES's W2 return. Classifies signals as Up (>+0.5%) or Down (<-0.5%) and computes average follow-through return, hit rate (same direction), and event count. Outputs: summary table with stats by direction and scatter plots of signal size vs response size.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES-CL LEAD-LAG STUDY (5-Min Bars, 8:00-9:00 AM ET)
# =============================================================================
# Window 1: 8:00-8:30 AM ET (signal window — first 30 min)
# Window 2: 8:30-9:00 AM ET (response window — next 30 min)
# Signal threshold: >0.5% absolute move in Window 1
# Test both directions: ES leads CL and CL leads ES
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCES ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

cl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(cl_ref.o, cl_ref.h, cl_ref.l, cl_ref.c, cl_ref.v, cl_ref.oi, cl_ref.s)

# ffill CL data to handle alignment gaps between ES and CL calendars
cl_o = ffill(cl_cont.o)
cl_h = ffill(cl_cont.h)
cl_l = ffill(cl_cont.l)
cl_c = ffill(cl_cont.c)

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
# Window 1: 8:00-8:30 AM ET (signal window)
es_w1 = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='08:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)
cl_w1 = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='08:30', tz='America/New_York'))(cl_o, cl_h, cl_l, cl_c)

# Window 2: 8:30-9:00 AM ET (response window)
es_w2 = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='09:00', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)
cl_w2 = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='09:00', tz='America/New_York'))(cl_o, cl_h, cl_l, cl_c)

# === WINDOW RETURNS ===
# W1 returns captured at W1 close, ffill_day to persist to W2 close bar
es_w1_ret = ffill_day(where(es_w1.closed, (es_w1.close - es_w1.open) / es_w1.open))
cl_w1_ret = ffill_day(where(cl_w1.closed, (cl_w1.close - cl_w1.open) / cl_w1.open))

# W2 returns (live at W2 close)
es_w2_ret = (es_w2.close - es_w2.open) / es_w2.open
cl_w2_ret = (cl_w2.close - cl_w2.open) / cl_w2.open

# === EVALUATION POINT (W2 close — 9:00 AM ET) ===
eval_bar = es_w2.closed

# === SIGNAL DETECTION (>0.5% absolute move in W1) ===
es_up = es_w1_ret > 0.005
es_down = es_w1_ret < -0.005
cl_up = cl_w1_ret > 0.005
cl_down = cl_w1_ret < -0.005

# =============================================================================
# DIRECTION 1: ES LEADS CL
# ES makes >0.5% move in W1 → measure CL's response in W2
# =============================================================================

# ES Up signal → CL response
es_up_cl_resp = where(eval_bar and es_up, cl_w2_ret)
es_up_cl_hit = where(eval_bar and es_up, (1.0 if cl_w2_ret > 0 else 0.0))

# ES Down signal → CL response
es_dn_cl_resp = where(eval_bar and es_down, cl_w2_ret)
es_dn_cl_hit = where(eval_bar and es_down, (1.0 if cl_w2_ret < 0 else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# DIRECTION 2: CL LEADS ES
# CL makes >0.5% move in W1 → measure ES's response in W2
# =============================================================================

# CL Up signal → ES response
cl_up_es_resp = where(eval_bar and cl_up, es_w2_ret)
cl_up_es_hit = where(eval_bar and cl_up, (1.0 if es_w2_ret > 0 else 0.0))

# CL Down signal → ES response
cl_dn_es_resp = where(eval_bar and cl_down, es_w2_ret)
cl_dn_es_hit = where(eval_bar and cl_down, (1.0 if es_w2_ret < 0 else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# SCATTER DATA (all >0.5% events, both up and down)
# =============================================================================

# ES leads CL scatter: X = ES W1 return, Y = CL W2 return
es_signal = (es_up or es_down)
scatter_es_x = where(eval_bar and es_signal, es_w1_ret)
scatter_es_y = where(eval_bar and es_signal, cl_w2_ret)

# CL leads ES scatter: X = CL W1 return, Y = ES W2 return
cl_signal = (cl_up or cl_down)
scatter_cl_x = where(eval_bar and cl_signal, cl_w1_ret)
scatter_cl_y = where(eval_bar and cl_signal, es_w2_ret)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Lead-Lag Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Lead-Lag Stats: ES\u2194CL (8:00\u20139:00 AM ET, 5-Min)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=[
            'ES Up (>+0.5%) \u2192 CL',
            'ES Down (<-0.5%) \u2192 CL',
            'CL Up (>+0.5%) \u2192 ES',
            'CL Down (<-0.5%) \u2192 ES'
        ],
        col_headers=['Avg Response', 'Hit Rate', 'Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Lead-Lag Stats'
)(es_up_cl_resp, es_up_cl_hit, es_up_cl_resp, es_dn_cl_resp, es_dn_cl_hit, es_dn_cl_resp, cl_up_es_resp, cl_up_es_hit, cl_up_es_resp, cl_dn_es_resp, cl_dn_es_hit, cl_dn_es_resp)

# --- Scatter: ES Leads CL ---
xy_scatter(
    title='ES W1 Return vs CL W2 Return (ES Leads)',
    x_axis_label='ES Window 1 Return',
    y_axis_label='CL Window 2 Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='ES\u2192CL', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category='2. ES Leads CL'
)(x=scatter_es_x, y_values=scatter_es_y)

# --- Scatter: CL Leads ES ---
xy_scatter(
    title='CL W1 Return vs ES W2 Return (CL Leads)',
    x_axis_label='CL Window 1 Return',
    y_axis_label='ES Window 2 Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='CL\u2192ES', color=Color.Teal, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category='3. CL Leads ES'
)(x=scatter_cl_x, y_values=scatter_cl_y)
